_comment: The Giulia project's bank plan (B5.1, specs/SPEC.md Block 6). Digests: the 16-hex prefixes the tools printed (G2h, G3, G2d). Decisions: claude/SBI_decisions_and_ideas_log.md in project knowledge.
_sim_dir: The hhgap simulator source (HPC_main_sweep.py, HPC_single_run.py; 37 registry axes), as the September export used it (EXTRACTOR_USAGE.md sec. 13.2).
_on_declared_box: D-074, D-078: natural units; [ln 0.01, ln 3.0] in the bank's coordinate.
_expected_p: G3: the 22 swept axes of every task's manifest plus the topology block conn_prob.
_t_win_s: D-041: one 180 s window per simulation. n_e: D-043. floor_hz: D-075.
_proposed: floor_rtol (Q7), sample_seed (Q6), bootstrap_resamples and bootstrap_seed (Q8): Claude's proposals, open in specs/SPEC.md sec. 8.
_bytes_sample_rows: D-080: kept sampled windows compressed together to estimate the bytes per row (proposed).
_rows_per_shard: B5.3: at most this many simulations per shard, so one array task never holds more than about 0.7 GB of windows (proposed).
_bank_root: D-046: the simulated bank's folder: shard_NNNN.npz + .json, tasks/, BANK_RECORD.json (B5.3-B5.4).
_real_bank_root: D-046, D-056: the real arm's 288 windows (B5.5).
_plan_out: D-079: gitignored, beside the tool, as sim_reextract/giulia/plan.json is.
